texts.li: [quirk:KeepsRecords] {A_nameDef} has written the question down in a little book, with the date, and brought the book to the council so the answer can go in it too.

lines.li: [quirk:KeepsRecords] The council answered {A_nameDef} straight, and {A_nameDef} wrote down every word, then read it back to check. The council had to correct itself twice.
[b:quirk:Storyteller] The council handed the question to {B_nameDef}, who answered it with a story, a long one with a wise old tortoise in it. {A_nameDef} has decided the tortoise was right.
[b:quirk:Proverbs] {B_nameDef} answered the question properly, and then summed it up in one old saying. {A_nameDef} has been repeating the saying ever since, to everyone, at every chance.

[quirk:Proverbs] {A_nameDef} has put down the heavy work with a proverb for the occasion: "an old horse knows the way home." {A_nameDef} sits in the sun now and supplies proverbs on request, and often without.
[quirk:Storyteller] {A_nameDef} has put down the heavy work, and the children have found {A_objective}. There's a story hour at {A_possessive} bench every afternoon now.
[quirk:KeepsRecords] {A_nameDef} is teaching {B_nameDef} from a notebook of everything {A_pronoun} has learned in forty years, every trick and every mistake, indexed. {B_nameDef} is on page three.
[quirk:Worrier] The council asked {A_nameDef} to keep going. {A_nameDef} went back to work, slower, and now lies awake worrying about what happens when {A_pronoun} can't.
[b:quirk:Proverbs] {A_nameDef} is {B_nameDef}'s apprentice now. The first lesson was "measure twice, cut once". So was the second. {A_nameDef} has measured everything in the workshop twice.
[quirk:WrongLaugh] {A_nameDef} made a stool, start to finish, and laughed so hard when it wobbled that {B_nameDef} started laughing too. They made a second one together. It wobbles less.
